第十七章 危机再现，秦易！（第二更求收）
果不其然，只见盖伦一笑，解释道，“因为这是‘英雄神典’的召唤法则。”
“召唤法则？”
“嗯。”点了点头，盖伦继续说道，“在吸收了重宝后，‘英雄神典’的灵魂告诉我，召唤是有法则限制，召唤每一个英雄，都需要消耗‘英雄神典’的能量，越强大的英雄，所需要的消耗也就越大。”
“特别是主人还要修复经脉，这双重的消耗，更是‘英雄神典’无法承受的。”
“因为这样，所以主人召唤的英雄就有了时间限制，特别是女性的英雄，消耗的能量就更多了，更别提互相交流了，而且，召唤女性英雄后还要付出一定的代价，不过‘英雄神典’说，已经将这代价转移到你身上了。”
“至于我……”盖伦笑了笑，将正义之剑插入地面上，“因为是主人第一个召唤的，所以我不受这个法则限制。”
若有所思的点了点头，秦轩并没有注意到盖伦后面那句‘将代价转移到你身上’的话。
“难怪，看来以后为了自己变强，还得继续给那家伙送重宝啊！”
想到这，秦轩心中一阵无奈，对于‘英雄神典’的灵魂，他可没什么好感，而且重宝啊，那可是足以引起众多强者疯狂抢夺的存在啊，竟然只是用来填饱‘英雄神典’的能量。
当然，这也不排除‘英雄神典’那神秘灵魂的私欲。
“主人，这家伙怎么处置？”盖伦指了指躺在地面的秦飞远。
眉头微微一皱，秦轩很想说一剑杀了，可是一想自己那名义上的师姐，也就是秦薇，这丫头可是南府的人，而且似乎还是这秦飞远的亲妹妹。
“算了，我们走吧。”
说罢，拿走秦飞远手指上的那枚空间戒子，秦轩便要离开，因为突然得知‘英雄神典’的能量问题，他可没时间耗下去，心思也都放在了如何解决重宝的事情上。
可就在这时，秦轩的脸色霎时间狂变，一股厚重的气息突然降临，仿若山岳一般，周围的空气都为之一凝，紧接着，一道犀利的剑芒迎面袭来……
剑芒速度奇快，迎风便涨，周围一些高大的树木皆是在这剑芒下化为齑粉，摧枯拉朽，势不可挡。
临至头顶时，剑芒已经足足有十多米。
盖伦想救，已经来不及了！
“勇气！”

怒吼一声，看着近在咫尺的剑芒，秦轩甚至感觉到了一丝死亡的味道，体内的玄气毫不保留的释放出来，声势浩荡，仿若奔雷。
而在他的体表，一圈金黄色的能量将其紧紧包裹住，就如金色蛋壳一般，密不透风，手中的灵器大剑同时朝剑芒抵挡而去。
灵器大剑第一时间被震得飞了出去，插入远处一株粗壮的大树内，发出轻微的呜咽剑吟声。
嗤嗤嗤。
剑芒气势不减，狠狠的落在那金黄色能量上，没有惊天动地的爆炸声，就仿佛水火不相容一般，两者不断的抵消着，恐怖的能量使得少年脚下的地面瞬间龟裂，如蛛网般朝四面扩散。
终于，盖伦赶了上来，手中的正义之剑往上一划，已经逐渐变得虚幻起来的剑芒，顿时偏移原来的轨迹，来到了秦飞远的头顶。
恐怖的剑芒将地面直接炸出一道深坑，热浪席卷开去，处于昏迷中的秦飞远更是倒霉得被轰得连渣都不剩。
“呼呼呼。”
坐在地上，秦轩大口大口的喘着粗气，脸色苍白，毫无血色，满头虚汗，身上的衣服更是被打湿，体表的金黄色能量咔嚓一声，仿若玻璃般破碎。
若是盖伦再迟一步，他怕是当场要死于非命了。
太恐怖了！太惊骇了！
这一剑，早已超脱了炼体九重的范畴，达到了气海境的实力！
“因为‘英雄神典’吸收了重宝，自己已经突破到了炼体八重的实力，可是……”秦轩胸口剧烈起伏着，心思却不断转换着，“为什么会感觉体内的玄气不够用？甚至出现虚弱的情况。”
虽说刚才那道恐怖的剑芒达到了气海境的境界，但是凭借秦轩的实力，还不至于抵挡了如此吃力，别人或许不知道，但是他却清楚，自己体内的玄气浑厚足以堪比一般的炼体九重圆满。
所以，秦轩疑惑了，随后他似乎想到了什么，心中咯噔一声，想到了盖伦提到的‘代价’。
莫非，这所谓的‘代价’便是将自己的玄气消耗殆尽？
如果真是这样的话，那一切也就说得通了。
啪啪啪。
一阵鼓掌的声音远远传来，随后便是几道破空声。
咻咻咻。

定睛望去，秦轩发先，来人只有三个，但是这三人的气息却是雄厚无比，有两股股甚至不比刚才的秦飞远弱，特别是中间那白衣男子，更是令人发悸，举手投足间，玄气涌动，如万马奔腾，又如浪水滔滔，气势骇人。
“没想到连这家伙也出现了。”看着白衣男子，秦轩的嘴角泛起一抹苦笑。
北府公子，秦家四府名义上年轻一辈的第一人，秦易，只见其手持一把青色长剑，剑身隐隐有风雷之声，显然，刚才那恐怖的剑芒正是他制造出来的。
扫了眼地面上横七竖八的尸体，秦易嘴角微微一翘，看着因为体力不支，在盖伦搀扶下重新站立起来的少年，眼里有一抹赞赏，“不错，能挡住我的一击，你值得骄傲了。”
秦轩撇了撇嘴，有些不屑，他与秦易的交际并不多，但也早就听说这小子高傲异常，或许因为天赋原因，眼中除了他自己外，根本没将任何人放在眼里。
看着秦易，特别是见到那副趾高气扬，天上地下唯我独尊的嘴脸，秦轩真的很想将其揍趴下，特别是想到刚才那一剑。
致命的一剑，险些要了自己性命的一剑！
“为了重宝，这些家伙一个个都要自己的命啊，可惜，如果让他们知道重宝已经被‘英雄神典’炼化吸收了，不知道会怎样。”
暗自叹了口气，秦轩的目光渐寒，可惜他体内的玄气就算有‘坚韧’的支持，也没那么快恢复，更别提重新召唤出菲奥娜了。
体内玄气空缺，秦轩就等于成为了一个普通人，就算他肉体再怎么强横，也不会傻到去跟一名气海境的强者硬碰硬。
况且，他身边还有两名实力不逊于秦飞远的炼体九重强者。
“看来有时间得将《修身诀》研究一番。”
摇了摇头，当初因为实力被困在炼体六重，所以老祖给予他的《修身诀》，他还未去翻开修炼。
“只能先退了。”暗自摇头，秦轩瞬间做出了决定。
有勇无谋是匹夫，明知不敌却硬要上，这是逞一时之勇，通俗点就是，脑子坏了。

Chapter 17 The crisis reappears, Qin Yi! (Second update asking for feedback)
As expected, Galen smiled and explained, "Because this is the summoning law of the 'Divine Code of Heroes'."
"Summoning Law?"
"Yes." Galen nodded and continued, "After absorbing the heavy treasure, the soul of the 'Hero's Dictionary' told me that summoning is restricted by laws. Summoning each hero requires consuming the energy of the 'Hero's Dictionary'. The more powerful the hero, the greater the consumption required."
"Especially since the master also needs to repair his meridians, this double consumption is beyond the capacity of the 'Divine Heroes'."
"Because of this, the heroes summoned by the master have a time limit, especially female heroes, which consume more energy, let alone communicate with each other. Moreover, you have to pay a certain price after summoning female heroes, but the 'Hero Divination' says that this price has been transferred to you."
"As for me..." Galen smiled and inserted the Sword of Justice into the ground, "Because I was the first to be summoned by the master, I am not restricted by this law."
Nodding thoughtfully, Qin Xuan didn't notice Galen's words behind him, "The price will be transferred to you."
"No wonder, it seems that in order to become stronger in the future, I have to continue to give that guy heavy treasures!"
Thinking of this, Qin Xuan felt helpless in his heart. He had no good impressions of the soul of the 'Heroes' Codex', and the treasure, which was enough to cause many strong men to snatch it madly, was only used to fill the energy of the 'Heroes' Codex'.
Of course, this does not rule out the selfish desires of the mysterious soul of the 'Divine Heroes'.
"Master, what should I do with this guy?" Galen pointed at Qin Feiyuan who was lying on the ground.
Frowning slightly, Qin Xuan wanted to say he would kill with one sword, but when he thought about his nominal senior sister, Qin Wei, this girl was from Nanfu, and she seemed to be Qin Feiyuan's biological sister.
"Forget it, let's go."
Having said that, after taking away the space ring from Qin Feiyuan's finger, Qin Xuan was about to leave. Because he suddenly learned about the energy problem of the 'Divine Code of Heroes', he had no time to waste it. He was also focused on how to solve the important treasure.
But at this moment, Qin Xuan's face suddenly changed wildly, and a heavy aura suddenly came, like a mountain, and the surrounding air condensed, and then, a sharp sword light came towards him...
The speed of the sword light is extremely fast, and it rises in the wind. Some of the tall trees around are turned into powder under the sword light, destroying and decaying, and it is unstoppable.
When it reached the top of the head, the sword light was already more than ten meters long.
Galen wanted to save him, but it was already too late!
"Courage!"
With an angry roar, Qin Xuan even felt a hint of death as he looked at the sword light so close to him. The profound energy in his body was released without reservation, with a mighty force, like thunder.
On his body surface, a circle of golden energy tightly wrapped him, just like a golden eggshell, airtight. The spiritual weapon sword in his hand simultaneously resisted the sword light.
The spiritual sword was immediately shaken and flew out, inserting itself into a thick tree in the distance, making a slight whimpering sound.
Tsk tsk tsk.
The momentum of the sword light did not diminish, and it fell hard on the golden energy. There was no earth-shattering explosion, as if water and fire were incompatible. The two were constantly canceling each other out. The terrifying energy caused the ground under the young man's feet to crack instantly and spread in all directions like a spider web.
Finally, Galen caught up and swiped the sword of justice in his hand upwards. The sword light, which had gradually become illusory, immediately deviated from its original trajectory and came to Qin Feiyuan's head.
The terrifying sword light directly blasted a deep pit into the ground, and a heat wave swept away. Qin Feiyuan, who was in a coma, was unlucky enough to be blasted to the ground.
"Hoo ho ho."
Sitting on the ground, Qin Xuan was breathing heavily, his face pale.White, bloodless, with sweat all over his head, the clothes on his body were even wet, and the golden energy on his body crackled, breaking like glass.
If Galen had been a step later, he might have died on the spot.
How horrible! So horrifying!
This sword has already transcended the realm of the ninth level of body refining and reached the strength of the Qi Sea realm!
"Because the 'Divine Code of Heroes' absorbed the heavy treasure, I have broken through to the eighth level of body refining, but..." Qin Xuan's chest rose and fell violently, but his mind kept changing, "Why do I feel that the profound energy in my body is not enough? I even feel weak."
Although the terrifying sword light just now reached the realm of Qi Sea Realm, with Qin Xuan's strength, it was not so difficult to withstand it. Others may not know it, but he knew that the profound energy in his body was rich enough to be comparable to the ordinary ninth level of body refining.
Therefore, Qin Xuan was confused, and then he seemed to think of something, and his heart thumped, thinking of the 'price' mentioned by Galen.
Could it be that this so-called ‘price’ is to consume all your own profound energy?
If that were the case, it would all make sense.
Snap, snap, snap.
A burst of applause came from afar, followed by several piercing sounds in the air.
Boo hoo hoo.
Looking closely, Qin Xuan was the first to come. There were only three people coming, but the auras of these three people were extremely powerful. Two of them were not even weaker than Qin Fei just now, especially the man in white in the middle, which was even more frightening. With every move of his hands and feet, the profound energy surged, like thousands of horses galloping, or like waves, with terrifying momentum.
"I didn't expect that even this guy would show up." Looking at the man in white, Qin Xuan had a wry smile on his lips.
Young Master Beifu, Qin Yi, nominally the first of the younger generation in the four houses of the Qin family, was seen holding a blue long sword, and there was a faint sound of wind and thunder on the sword. It was obvious that the terrifying sword light just now was created by him.
Glancing at the scattered corpses on the ground, Qin Yi raised the corner of his mouth slightly. He looked at the young man who stood up again with Galen's help due to lack of physical strength. There was a hint of appreciation in his eyes, "Not bad, you can block my blow. You should be proud."
Qin Xuan curled his lips with some disdain. He didn't have much interaction with Qin Yi, but he had long heard that this boy was extremely arrogant. Perhaps because of his talent, he didn't take anyone else seriously except himself.
Looking at Qin Yi, especially seeing his arrogant and domineering face, Qin Xuan really wanted to beat him to the ground, especially when he thought of the sword strike just now.
A fatal sword, a sword that almost killed me!
"For the sake of the Chongbao, each of these guys will kill themselves. Unfortunately, if they know that the Chongbao has been refined and absorbed by the 'Divine Heroes', I don't know what will happen."
Sighing secretly, Qin Xuan's eyes grew colder. Unfortunately, even if the profound energy in his body had the support of 'tenacity', it could not recover so quickly, let alone summon Fiona again.
Without the profound energy in his body, Qin Xuan has become an ordinary person. No matter how strong his body is, he will not be stupid enough to go head-to-head with a strong man in the Qi Sea Realm.
Moreover, there are two strong men at the ninth level of body refining beside him who are not inferior to Qin Feiyuan.
"It seems that I have to study the Secret of Self-cultivation when I have time."
He shook his head. He was trapped in the sixth level of body refining due to his strength, so he had not yet opened the "Skill Cultivation Technique" given to him by his ancestor.
"We can only retreat first." Shaking his head secretly, Qin Xuan made an instant decision.
A man who is brave but has no plans is a man who insists on attacking even though he knows he is outmatched. This is a momentary act of bravery. In layman's terms, it means that his brain is broken.
(How to break the chrysanthemum? Please help me brothers, push it up!
